data.user_prompt: What enterprise AI training and consulting services does JasonZhu.AI offer?

sections.text:
JasonZhu.AI offers two main enterprise services:

- **Enterprise AI training:** Customized programs ranging from AI awareness to hands-on implementation, covering:
  - Prompt engineering, from beginner to advanced
  - AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot
  - AI-assisted copywriting, image generation, and video production
  - AI office productivity, including data analysis, document processing, and workflow automation
  - Custom courses tailored to a company’s workflows and business scenarios[1][2]

- **AI consulting:** End-to-end technical and transformation support, including:
  - AI application prototyping and MVP development
  - AI workflow and agent development
  - Business AI transformation planning
  - Technology-stack selection and architecture consulting
  - AI website and tool development, from requirements analysis through delivery[1][3]

Training is designed around real business use cases and emphasizes hands-on practice. Example programs include AI coding for development teams, AI productivity training, AI website development, automation, and building agents for company-specific scenarios.[4][5][7]
